decisions.reason: After two years without website visibility, a relatively simple net price display plugin is more likely to be absorbed into general shop services than maintained as a standalone product.
An ERP system interface plugin still supports the firm's core end-to-end e-commerce integration strategy, so management would be inclined to retain it despite reduced visibility.
With no recent website presence and clear overlap with other price comparison tracking tools, this plugin is a strong candidate for portfolio consolidation.
This tracking plugin remains strategically adjacent to the marketing offer, but overlap and lack of recent promotion make discontinuation more likely than retention.
Among the similar price comparison tracking plugins, this one has the highest likelihood of being retired as the firm concentrates resources on broader multichannel and optimization work.
A net price reporting plugin still fits the firm's analytics-oriented extension business and may justify continued support for existing shop clients.
